title: Quiz: Input and Output
description: Check your understanding of Input and Output.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in Java?
questions.explanation: In Java, // marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: What does the print/output function do?
options: Sends text or values to the screen or console
questions.correctAnswer: Sends text or values to the screen or console

questions.question: True or False: User input is usually received as a string, even when the user typed a number.
Fill in the blank: System.out.println("Hello");
questions.explanation: Use the language's standard output function.

questions.question: In Java, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
